title: About the Other Day
objective: Say it plainly this time: you like her company, with or without anything to treat.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna hands you a cup of something hot.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She finds her spectacles on her head on the first try. It seems to unsettle her.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “You said something kind. I’ve been turning it over. It answered a question I didn’t ask.”

options.labelText: “You work too hard. Take a day off and let someone else mind the infirmary for a while.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Doctor Leeches says that too. He also says leeches.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She takes the cup back and drinks the mint herself. Then she says goodbye.

options.labelText: “I said it wrong. I like your company. Sprains optional.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She writes your name on a label and ties it to the chair nearest the stove.
